description: This file defines the Maplace.js library, a JavaScript module for creating and managing Google Maps with various controls, markers, and overlays. It includes classes, methods, and controls for map visualization, marker management, and route directions.

classes.name: Maplace
classes.description: Main class for creating and controlling Google Maps with markers, overlays, and controls.

methods.name: create_objMap
methods.description: Initializes the Google Map object with options and styles.

methods.name: add_markers_to_objMap
methods.description: Adds markers or overlays to the map based on configuration.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the map with specified options and locations, initializing controls and markers.

methods.name: ViewOnMap
methods.description: Triggers map to focus on a specific location or view all.

methods.name: CloseInfoWindow
methods.description: Closes any open info window on the map.

methods.name: SetLocations
methods.description: Replaces current locations with new ones.

methods.name: AddLocations
methods.description: Adds multiple locations to the existing list.

methods.name: AddLocation
methods.description: Adds a single location at a specific index.

methods.name: RemoveLocations
methods.description: Removes specified locations from the list.

methods.name: perform_load
methods.description: Performs initial map view based on locations.

methods.name: generate_controls
methods.description: Creates and attaches control menus to the map.

methods.name: init_map
methods.description: Resets map, markers, bounds, and listeners.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Namespace for creating map overlays like markers, polylines, polygons, and directions.
